objective: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

description: Here's our next step: there're ogres all around the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. We're gonna need to activate the tower's defenses if you're gonna stand a chance against 'em an' still make it to the items alive. To do that, we're gonna need some gems the Boulderfist shaman have taken a liking to. They took 'em from the tower, but they're not gonna stay in their possession for long.
Get one of them gems an' bring 'em to Kryten--he knows the spell to enchant 'em so they'll work as a key.
progress: <name>, hello again. Have you found an azure agate yet?
completion: You amaze me, <name>. Well done again.
Give me a moment to cast the proper spell to enchant the gem, an' you'll be ready.
